dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should take Skirk somewhere she can rest! Hmm, but where...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon gets the feeling Skirk wouldn't like being around a lot of people... Oh, wait! Baizhu said we could rest in the back room of the pharmacy, didn't he? Let's head there!
